{{TOC|side}}
One can assign magazines, weapons or vehicles (units, vehicles, objects, etc) with nameSound a reference to the [[Arma_3_Radio_Protocol|radio protocol]].
So when AI, or the player, tries to name an entity via radio chat it determines what sound file is to be played and what text to be shown.

== Relevant Parameters ==

* {{hl|nameSound}} in:
** [[CfgMagazines_Config_Reference#nameSound.3D.22magazine.22|CfgMagazines]]
** [[CfgWeapons_Config_Reference#nameSound.3D.22.22|CfgWeapons]]
** [[CfgVehicles_Config_Reference#nameSound|CfgVehicles]]
* {{hl|textSingular}}/{{hl|textPlural}} in:
** [[Arma 3: Radio Protocol#Vehicle Words|CfgVehicles]]
